name: Indeed
description: Search and retrieve job listings, access detailed job descriptions and requirements, and provide direct job links to users. This integration streamlines the job search process by bringing Indeed's extensive job database and company information directly into Claude conversations, enabling seamless career exploration, job searching, and employment research capabilities.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Indeed to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Indeed to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.indeed.com/claude/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Indeed MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Indeed provides these MCP tools: search_jobs and get_job_details.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Indeed?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Indeed in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Indeed requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Indeed is developed by Indeed. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
